_schema: See CLAUDE.md standards/usecases/ for field definitions

usecases.useCase: Home Depot Pro lead intake → Salesforce Lead creation (scheduled, 10-minute polling)
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Scheduled poll of HD Portal API every 10 minutes; lead records (keyed by F-number) created in Salesforce as Lead objects with HD source attribution.
usecases.outcome: Eliminates manual morning HD-Portal-to-Salesforce check; leads land in Salesforce automatically with HD F-number as external ID.
usecases.aiLayer: Phase 1 prerequisite for AgentForce-driven HD lead triage / auto-acknowledgement (Phase 3).

clients.projectContext: UC1 — HD Portal lead → Salesforce Lead, scheduled polling pattern with 10-minute cadence, F-number as the lead identifier

usecases.useCase: Salesforce 'Save as Final' quote → ComputerEase Job + Customer + Budget Worksheet creation
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Event-driven flow triggered by Salesforce quote 'Save as Final' status transition; creates ComputerEase Job (sequential numbering by company code + product line + initials), Customer, and Budget Worksheet via the Deltek-managed integration URL routed through CE Live Service.
usecases.outcome: Replaces the ~1.5-hour-per-job manual rekey Ashley currently performs between Salesforce and ComputerEase.
usecases.aiLayer: Phase 1 prerequisite for AgentForce job-margin watch and budget-worksheet draft suggestion (Phase 3).

clients.projectContext: UC2 — Salesforce Quote → ComputerEase Job via CE Live Service relay; company code 00 for IL/WI HD residential

usecases.useCase: Signed contract PDFs (HS-105, 299A, 299B, HS-118) extracted via MuleSoft IDP and validated against Salesforce quote/contract data
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Event-driven flow on Salesforce quote 'Save as Final' + signed-document upload; MuleSoft IDP extracts fields; deterministic rule engine validates (signature legibility, Friday-date, 299A=299B price match, single yes/no-box, permit flag, deposit threshold with Wisconsin 99% exception); discrepancies flagged for write-back.
usecases.outcome: Replaces manual document-by-document contract review with exception-only review.
usecases.aiLayer: MuleSoft IDP for extraction; deterministic rules layer for validation. Phase 1 prerequisite for AgentForce exception-triage agent.

clients.projectContext: UC3 — IDP validation of HS-105, 299A, 299B, HS-118 against Salesforce quote data; Wisconsin-specific 99% deposit rule encoded

usecases.useCase: Salesforce → HD Portal exception / comment write-back when contract validation fails
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Event-driven flow triggered when UC3 validation fails; structured comment posted to the HD lead screen and/or email sent to the HD account-manager channel (Greg) instead of advancing the job.
usecases.outcome: Replaces Peerless's current manual practice of writing a comment on the HD screen — automated, structured, traceable.
usecases.aiLayer: Phase 1 prerequisite for AgentForce-generated exception narrative (replace structured comment with an AI-summarized exception explanation in Phase 3).

clients.projectContext: UC4 — Salesforce → HD Portal comment / email write-back on contract validation failure

usecases.useCase: Home Depot Pro lead → ServiceTitan CRM pre-population (eliminates manual rekey)
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Installer contractors using ServiceTitan manage HD bookings, online requests, and call-center leads from a single intake — HD leads land pre-populated with customer info, job type, and campaign source.
usecases.outcome: Eliminates hours of manual lead data entry; staff time redirected to conversion-and-scheduling.
usecases.aiLayer: Foundation for AI scheduling agents on the CRM side (route density / availability / SLA).

usecases.useCase: AI-driven construction contract review and risk-clause validation
usecases.whatWasBuilt: Document Crunch reduces construction contract review from weeks to minutes; AI identifies ambiguities, validates clauses, flags risk language and missing required fields.
usecases.outcome: Contract review time compressed from weeks to minutes; exception-only review replaces document-by-document review.
